    sep_c = set()

            sep_r.add(r)
    for c in range(cols):
        if all(grid[r][c] == sep_val for r in range(rows)):
            sep_c.add(c)

    signals = [] # (br_idx, bc_idx, local_r, local_c, val)

    br_list = []
    curr = 0
    for r in sorted(sep_r):
        if r > curr:
            br_list.append((curr, r))
        curr = r
    if curr < rows:
        br_list.append((curr, rows))
        
    bc_list = []
    curr = 0
    for c in sorted(sep_c):
        if c > curr:
            bc_list.append((curr, c))
        curr = c
    if curr < cols:
        bc_list.append((curr, cols))
        
    signals = []
    for br_idx in range(len(br_list)):
        br_start, br_end = br_list[br_idx]
        for bc_idx in range(len(bc_list)):

    # Output

    for s in signals:

        if br_idx not in br_sig:
            br_sig[br_idx] = {}
        if (lr, lc) not in br_sig[br_idx]:
            br_sig[br_idx][(lr, lc)] = val
    
    # Apply Horizontal Fill
    for br_idx in range(len(br_list)):
        br_sig_map = br_sig.get(br_idx, {})
        for bc_idx in range(len(bc_list)):
            bc_start, bc_end = bc_list[bc_idx]
            br_start, br_end = br_list[br_idx]
            for r in range(br_start, br_end):
                for c in range(bc_start, bc_end):
                    lr, lc = r - br_start, c - bc_start
                    if (lr, lc) in br_sig_map:
                        res[r][c] = br_sig_map[(lr, lc)]
                        
    # Vertical Fill
    bc_sig = {}
    for s in signals:
        br_idx, bc_idx, lr, lc, val = s
        if bc_idx not in bc_sig:
            bc_sig[bc_idx] = {}
        if (lr, lc) not in bc_sig[bc_idx]:
            bc_sig[bc_idx][(lr, lc)] = val
            
    for bc_idx in range(len(bc_list)):
        bc_sig_map = bc_sig.get(bc_idx, {})
        for br_idx in range(len(br_list)):
            bc_start, bc_end = bc_list[bc_idx]
            br_start, br_end = br_list[br_idx]
            for r in range(br_start, br_end):
                for c in range(bc_start, bc_end):
                    lr, lc = r - br_start, c - bc_start
                    if (lr, lc) in bc_sig_map:
                        res[r][c] = bc_sig_map[(lr, lc)]
                        
    return res
